description: Comprehensive racial, augmetic, and psychological traits for Warhammer 40k: Hive Tartarus Sub-Level 404.

trait_iron_discipline.name: Iron Discipline (Astra Militarum)
trait_iron_discipline.effect: Hardened by harsh military service; suppresses panic and fear in the line of duty.

trait_transhuman_physiology.name: Transhuman Physiology (Astartes)
trait_transhuman_physiology.effect: Nineteen implanted gene-seed organs make the Space Marine virtually immune to biological shock.

trait_and_they_shall_know_no_fear.name: And They Shall Know No Fear

trait_bionic_endurance.name: Augmetic Flesh-Replacement
trait_bionic_endurance.effect: Sub-dermal plasteel plating and bionic limbs reduce vulnerability to kinetic trauma.

trait_cold_logic.name: Cold Logic (Cant Mechanicus)
trait_cold_logic.effect: Replaces volatile human emotion with pure computational binary.

trait_colossal_frame.name: Colossal Muscle Frame (Ogryn)
trait_colossal_frame.effect: Towering muscle mass and thick bone density allow monstrous physical feats.

trait_simple_loyalty.name: Simple Loyalty (Ogryn)
trait_simple_loyalty.effect: Childlike devotion to the Commissar and the Emperor protects against heresy.

trait_diminutive_stealth.name: Diminutive Stature & Stealth (Ratling)
trait_diminutive_stealth.effect: Small size allows slipping through vents and unseen movement in the dark.

trait_eagle_eye.name: Eagle-Eye Marksman (Ratling)
trait_eagle_eye.effect: Superhuman visual clarity for long-range sniper fire.

trait_fleet_of_foot.name: Fleet of Foot (Aeldari)
trait_fleet_of_foot.effect: Uncanny xenos grace and blinding acrobatic reflexes.

trait_path_discipline.name: Path Discipline (Aeldari)
trait_path_discipline.effect: Rigorous psychic focus keeps Slaanesh's soul-drain at bay.

trait_fungoid_durability.name: Fungoid Resilience (Ork)
trait_fungoid_durability.effect: Spore-based anatomy lacks vital organs in human positions; wounds regenerate rapidly.

trait_the_waaagh.name: Gestalt WAAAGH! Field (Ork)
trait_the_waaagh.effect: Collective psychic belief strengthens green skin muscle and weapon reliability.

trait_reanimation_protocols.name: Reanimation Protocols (Necron)
trait_reanimation_protocols.effect: Living metal necrodermis self-assembles and repairs catastrophic damage.

trait_soulless_metal.name: Soulless Necrodermis (Necron)
trait_soulless_metal.effect: Total absence of warp soul grants complete immunity to psychic corruption and fear.

trait_the_greater_good.name: Philosophy of the Greater Good (T'au)
trait_the_greater_good.effect: Selfless devotion to the caste and collective battle-doctrine.

trait_warp_blind.name: Warp-Blind Soul (T'au)
trait_warp_blind.effect: Extremely dim presence in the Immaterium makes Tau virtually invisible to Daemons.

trait_broodmind_telepathy.name: Broodmind Telepathy (Genestealer Hybrid)
trait_broodmind_telepathy.effect: Psychic link to the Patriarch coordinates ambush vectors and blinds fear.

trait_chitin_plates.name: Sub-Dermal Chitin (Genestealer Hybrid)
trait_chitin_plates.effect: Hardened insectoid exoskeleton ridges provide natural kinetic deflection.

trait_fanatical_faith.name: Zealot of the Imperial Creed
trait_fanatical_faith.effect: The Emperor protects; prayer fortifies the soul against psychic dread and dissonance.

trait_toxic_sump_rot.name: Sump Lung & Chemical Poisoning
trait_toxic_sump_rot.effect: Prolonged exposure to sulfur vents and industrial runoff degrades respiratory tissues.

trait_unyielding_survival.name: Imperial Will to Endure
trait_unyielding_survival.effect: Stubborn refusal to die before duty to the Golden Throne is discharged.
trait_unyielding_survival.vulnerability: Physical collapse under sustained heavy trauma when flesh reaches biological breaking point.

trait_necrodermis_cellular_weave.name: Necrodermis Chrono-Weave (The Silent King's Grace)
trait_necrodermis_cellular_weave.effect: Living metal micro-threads and chronomantic particles re-knitted pulverized flesh and bone, granting self-repairing cellular resilience.

trait_void_ascension.name: Void Ultramarine Ascension
trait_void_ascension.effect: Transmuted by warp paradox and hatred of the Imperium into an unkillable avatar of the void.

trait_malgakor_soul_fusion.name: Soul-Host of Lord Malgakor
trait_malgakor_soul_fusion.effect: Hosts the immortal warp-essence of the slain Chaos God-Lord; draws limitless power from the Immaterium.

trait_immortal_awakened_yellow_energy.name: The Immortal Awakened (Primordial Yellow Energy)
trait_immortal_awakened_yellow_energy.effect: Enveloped in a primordial yellow luminescence that transcends both the God-Emperor of Mankind and the Ruinous Powers of Chaos. The endless cycles of suffering and vengeance are permanently severed. Physical vitality is set to -99 (Immortal, unkillable across all dimensional realities).
